title: 1 hour XGBoost trained on archived real-time ACE solar wind for 2001 to 2016, scored on validation
split: validation only, 2017-01-01 .. 2020-12-31; train rows end before 2017-01-01; the test years are never predicted

configuration.reference: production: models/xgb_dst_1h.ubj loaded by scripts/live_forecast.py predict_xgb

variants.omni: scripts/train_xgb.py defaults retrained with each seed (seed 0 is the production configuration): seed noise
variants.ace_rt: train rows 2001-01-01 .. 2016-12-31 with real-time ACE solar wind delayed 1 hour, Dst and F10.7 from OMNI; train_xgb.py --train-inputs ace_rt
variants.omni+ace_rt: OMNI train rows 1995 .. 2016 plus the ACE copy (K = 1); train_xgb.py --train-inputs omni+ace_rt
variants.seed mean: mean forecast of the seeds of one variant

configuration.early_stopping: validation years with OMNI inputs, as production

validation_inputs.ace_delay1h: issue 31 real-time ACE inputs delayed 1 hour

configuration.scored_hours: 35,039 issue hours from 2017-01-02T00:00 to 2020-12-31T22:00, the same for every model and input

bootstrap.intervals: 95%; differences are model minus production on the same inputs
